items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John Lewis, yeah. I worshiped him from afar.

ctx.x: John Lewis, yeah. I worshiped him from afar. He was with the Modern Jazz Quartet.
By the time you arrived in New York, the MJQ was in full swing. And he’d played with Dizzy Gillespie’s band, so you may have heard him on the road back in the ‘40s when you were in Mississippi.
